purpose: Read and troubleshoot existing Cloudflare/D1 visit counters.
notes: counter_monthly reads /api/monthly and never increments the counter. ONECLICKVIRT_COUNTER_URL may set the HTTPS base URL of an existing deployment.
Counter creation uses /api/create with the existing deployment's authCode; keep that secret out of source, prompts and documentation. MCP exposes monthly statistics only.
purpose_zh: 读取并排查已有 Cloudflare/D1 访问计数器。
notes_zh: counter_monthly 只读取 /api/monthly，不增加访问计数。可用 ONECLICKVIRT_COUNTER_URL 指定已有部署的 HTTPS 地址。
新建计数器的 /api/create 使用部署现有 authCode，该凭据不得写入源码、提示词或文档。MCP 仅提供月统计查询。
